Callout.Name: Chimney Fire
Callout.Message: Chimney fire in an old house, smoke from the roof.
Callout.Advisory: Occupants out, fire contained so far.

Script.Line: It is in the chimney. It has been going since the fire was lit.
The sweep was booked for next month. That is the truth of it.
I have not put water on it. Somebody told me not to.

Lines.Approach: It is in the chimney for now and the householder is watching it. That is not a plan.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
